content.short: Ethos Wallet is a comprehensive Web3 wallet and discovery platform natively built for the Sui network.
content.description: Ethos Wallet is a fully-featured digital wallet designed specifically for the Sui blockchain ecosystem. It provides users with a secure and intuitive interface for managing digital assets, NFTs, and interacting seamlessly with decentralized applications. Beyond standard wallet capabilities, Ethos integrates discovery tools that allow users to explore popular dapps and games natively. Its architecture is optimized for Sui's object-centric model and high-speed execution.
